connector.name: Recite MCP
connector.registryDescription: Local MCP server for Recite receipt processing with ledger and memory tools.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package recite-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the rivradev account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.description: Optional local data directory for config, ledger, and memory files.
